name: box
title: Box
orientation: Open side up on the bed. Walls and corner posts are straight up, so it prints without supports.

width.rule: Room for small things: keys, a watch, earrings
width.label: Width

depth.rule: Room for small things, front to back
depth.label: Depth

height.rule: A whole number of layers, deep enough for the screws' pilots
height.label: Height

wall.rule: Four print lines: stiff, and no gaps between lines

inset.rule: Each screw this far in from the outer faces: the wall, then a post round the screw's pilot, eight lines from its centre to the wall
